strongest_angle: NASA Earth Observatory satellites captured a skull-shaped ice and rock formation on Vega Island in October 2026, revealing how unusually warm winter temperatures exposed dark ice and accelerated melting.

key_facts.fact: On Vega Island in the Weddell Sea, NASA Earth Observatory satellites observed an ice-covered land feature resembling a grinning human skull on October 30, 2026.
According to ScienceDaily and NDTV reports from November 2026, unusually warm winter temperatures across Antarctica exposed large areas of dark ice on Vega Island, threatening faster glacial melting.
The Times of India reported in October 2026 that satellite views of Vega Island near the Antarctic Peninsula display a rocky peak functioning as an eye socket and a lateral moraine forming the jaw.
